verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a self-hosted gateway with virtual keys, spend tracking, and routing across Azure/OpenAI deployments. No item documents supplying your own upstream provider API keys or having the gateway use them for your traffic. Virtual keys are gateway-issued credentials for access control and budgets, a related but different feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own provider API keys and have the gateway use them for my traffic
